rulings: Ruling: Treat the explicit user reactivation after the published design approval block as direction to proceed with the recommended design — the user resumed this exact stopped goal after seeing the concrete choice — if this interpretation is wrong, the optional clone policy may need revision; full clone remains the default.

Ruling: Continue inline on the existing clean dedicated branch without another linked checkout — prior workspace choice and the resumed plan preserve this working method — no separate-checkout isolation from this directory.

Ruling: Keep cohesive helpers below 300 lines rather than pad them or merge unrelated lifetimes — the 300–600 sizing target conflicts with the requested explicit module boundaries for small pure parsers/policy/cache helpers — if a strict minimum of 300 was intended, these helpers will need consolidation. The 600-line ceiling is preserved in changed product modules.

Ruling: Verify the enlarged renderer-enabled suite in two exhaustive, disjoint serial groups with the original 15-minute/3-worker limits — the single invocation hit its existing limit while still making test progress — all files retain coverage, but this does not prove a single monolithic invocation finishes inside 15 minutes under current load.

Ruling: Run the one final whole-branch review inside Task11 before its completion line — this task explicitly includes review while the generic task loop places review after the final task — the completion ledger is written later; no review or verification gate is omitted.

Ruling: Apply the approved ten-page review-comment limit to Preview Files while keeping its separate thirty-page changed-files limit — the binding M1 design specifies ten comment pages and forbids successful remaining-tail truncation — a 1001–3000-comment preview that could previously finish now reports the explicit limit rather than showing a partial or unbounded result.
